name: 53225 · Milwaukee, WI
findings: ZIP 53225 (Milwaukee) has 81 nonprofit organizations. 40 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 35 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53225 (Milwaukee) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
